newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Lower Chamber of Deputies starts debates on bill on staff employed in education system.
* Senate passed a bill on hospitals.

* Romanian President Ion Iliescu had talks with Canadian Industry Minister John Manley and discused on results of bilateral economic ties. Manley also met Prime Minister Nicolae Vacaroiu. Manley said Canada would to suport Romania in developing its communications sector and aircraft industry.
* The Constitutional Court rejected contestations lodged against candidatures of Ion Iliescu, Emil Constantinescu, Constantin Mudava and Tudor Mohora for presidential polls.
